'''Brian Hunter DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brian Hunter]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-17916">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17916 DeckTech post 17916], DeckTech (TJ "Techmaster" Holman, 29 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17916/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17916/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Published:''' 29 July 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat CCT Hunter DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Hunter's Obsession: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Brian hunter asked me to post this deck for him, something about his obsession with the amish and oompa loompas or sumthin i dunno.

== Original post ==

'''Raping An Amish Oompa Loompa Done RIGHT'''
* '''Author:''' TJ "Techmaster" Holman
* '''Published:''' July 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Brian hunter asked me to post this deck for him, something about his obsession with the amish and oompa loompas or sumthin i dunno.

=== Strategy ===

I dont really no how to play the deck, ive never raped an amish oompa loompa so pleeze direct your questions to brian hunter.

Techmaster
